name: Black Bean Soup with Feta & Kale, Apple & Pecan Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 green bell peppers
3 Gala apples
1 ½ bunch kale

instructions.primary_message: Quarter the bell peppers lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Small dice the peppers (cut into 6-mm cubes) and transfer to a large bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onions and remove the outer layer; small dice the onions (cut into 6-mm cubes) and add to the bell peppers.
Once the saucepan is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the bell peppers and onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, cumin, and crushed red pepper to the saucepan; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp cumin
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the broth and beans (with their liquid) to the saucepan; season with salt and pepper. Increase the heat to high and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans black beans
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: In a large salad bowl, combine and whisk together olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut out and discard the kale stems; chop the leaves crosswise into 1 ¼-cm strips. Add the kale to the salad bowl and, using your hands, massage the dressing into the leaves.
Quarter the apples lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the salad bowl.
Roughly chop the pecans and add to the salad bowl. Toss the salad to combine.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until the desired consistently is reached. Alternatively, mash the beans with a potato masher.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and garnish with feta. Serve with the kale salad on the side. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
